rapport_notes: Nicole is warm, patient, and professional throughout; maintains a friendly tone and handles customer clarifications smoothly.
process_discipline_notes: Damage coverage ($2,000) mentioned twice: once in Stage 1 when customer asked about TV insurance, and again in Stage 2 as part of the differentiators package. Missing explicit rate-lock line at close.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I'll be starting with a few questions together on the right track. This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes and we'll be able to build you an accurate code.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'Just pricing' — Nicole acknowledged but did not probe deeper (e.g., 'Tell me more about pricing' or 'What else matters to you beyond cost?'). No follow-up on the single concern raised.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with_stage1: you guys have insurance that will cover it right? If something happens to it. → Yes, we do. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair replace or reimburse for any accidental damages
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming_stage2: we have a meter mover feature. A few days before the move, you will be receiving an email introducing the movers to you. You will have an option to see their photos and basic info
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: we have on time guarantee if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill
evidence_quotes.communication: you will be receiving an email introducing the movers to you... the time start as soon as we get on site, and open the contract
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: for a typical one bedroom apartment. It usually takes around two and a half to three and a half hours to completely move locally in your case since you're moving from a fort floor apartment to a two story house with 25 minutes drive time between location. I will estimate this move to take around three to four hours.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: once we go over the minimum, the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: we will be charging you for the total time consumed by the end of the move

top_strength: Nicole delivered a complete, organized discovery phase with a clear quid pro quo framing, asked the agenda question early, and covered all four major differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, Communication) at appropriate points in the call.
coaching_note: When the customer states a single concern ('Just pricing'), probe at least one layer deeper—'What about pricing concerns you most?' or 'Beyond cost, anything else we should address today?'—rather than pivoting immediately to logistics; also include the rate-lock line and an explicit close ask (e.g., 'Would you like us to help with your move?') to complete the close sequence.
